expected.title: Thanksgiving Sidecar
expected.ingredients_raw:
Cranberry Jelly:
1 cup sugar
1 cup water
3 cups cranberries
Pumpkin Pie Sugar:
1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice, such as McCormick
5 teaspoons sugar
1 dash Angostura Aromatic bitters
¼ ounce cranberry jelly
¼ ounce maple syrup
½ ounce Grand Marnier
¾ ounce lemon juice
¾ ounce rye, preferably Old Overholt
¾ ounce Laird’s Straight Apple Brandy bottled-in-bond
Pumpkin pie sugar, to sprinkle on top
